review.notes: Full review of the whole folder. Seeded sample (1.4, 1.8, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 3.1, 3.2, 4.3, 4.5, 5.2, 5.6, 6.1, 6.3, 6.5, 6.6) and the four headlines checked by computation, with further rows for 1.2, 1.2a, 2.6, 5.3-5.5, 5.7, 6.3a, 6.7, 6.7a, 6.7b; 44 source locators read in six sources (Gaudron 2008, Bost 2001, Bost 1996, Chen 2010, Bost-Kunnemann 2010, Gaudron-Remond 2014), all correct; four statements of the formal proof opened and compared; 47 library declarations found at the pins; 57 cross-roadmap citations resolved on main and at open heads; duplication searched by object across main, all open heads and the pinned libraries. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with no message and declares nothing (no headline statable at the pins). Not read: six paywalled works cited without locators; a few numerically computed values in the Checks of 6.7a and 6.7b were not recomputed. One small correction (the paragraph of 4.3 titled as the form of the formal proof), two format notes; two questions for the human reviewers (scope and licence of the formal proof as a source).
